title: Willowshore Resident — Place in Town (d100)
note: Roots a NEW Willowshore townsperson in the gazetteer: their FACTION/bank lean, the real W-location/trade they work or frequent, and a FAITH. Fires in CONJUNCTION with the AC Character Crafter (which gives identity/relationship). Roll once for a composite read, or read it as faction-tier so you can re-roll trade and faith separately if you prefer. Allegiance is NOT strictly by residence — many are Unaffiliated (default indifferent). Northridge = post-Lung-Wa pragmatist arrivals (north bank); Southbank = founder-family traditionalists (south bank). Faiths present in town: Abadar, Daikitsu, Lady Nanbyo, Pharasma, plus small shrines (Calistria, Desna, Ketephys, Kofusachi, Lao Shu Po, Nalinivati, Qi Zhong, Shelyn, Shizuru, Tsukiyo, Yaezhing) and the Sangpotshi philosophy. Keep faction stance, faith, and trade consistent with the NPC the Crafter produced.
